title: build-planner inputs
description: Typed inputs for the build-planner runtime agent. Machine-readable mirror of the Inputs table in AGENT.md. The harness validates caller-supplied input packets against this schema before the agent begins work; validation failures surface the offending field to the caller rather than failing mid-run. One input by design: everything a plan needs — the requirement, the questions, the answers, the G1 record — already lives in the build directory, and a second input is a second copy of a fact that can drift from it.

build_dir.description: The build directory produced by /clarify-requirements. Must contain requirement.md and a plan.json whose 'clarifications' gate (G1) is approved. Example from AGENT.md: ".sfskills/builds/case-onboarding". Required column: 'yes'.
